description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different model configurations during Whisper fine-tuning. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A yellow-orange line with circular markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int4", starting at a WER of approximately 36 at epoch 0 and decreasing to a WER of approximately 26 at epoch 6. An orange line with square markers represents "small AdaLoRA_int8", beginning at a WER of approximately 30 at epoch 0 and decreasing to a WER of approximately 25 at epoch 6. A brown line with diamond markers represents "small int4", starting at a WER of approximately 34 at epoch 0 and decreasing to a WER of approximately 26 at epoch 6. A dark orange line with triangular markers represents "small int8", beginning at a WER of approximately 32.5 at epoch 0 and decreasing to a WER of approximately 25.5 at epoch 6.
